coverage: winui-shell-check scans var-based Button, ComboBox, Slider, ToggleSwitch, CheckBox, TextBox and NumberBox construction in MainWindow.CompatibilityPreview.cs.
The gate requires a non-empty AutomationProperties.SetName call for each detected control and reports the control type, variable, source and line on failure.
Offline self-tests cover valid, missing-name and empty-name C# cases alongside the existing four XAML cases; the real Compatibility Preview source passes at 14 detected controls.

limitations: The source scan recognizes the documented var construction pattern and literal SetName calls; it is not a compiled XAML or UI Automation runtime audit.
Compatibility Preview remains non-formal UI evidence; this change adds source-gate coverage only and makes no physical-audio or driver claim.
